stem.text: A train of mass $3.3 \times 10^{6}\,\text{kg}$ is moving at a constant speed up a slope inclined at an angle of $0.64^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. The engine of the train is producing a useful output power of $14\,\text{MW}$.
Assume that there are no frictional forces opposing the motion of the train.
What is the speed of the train?
